About Surin

Surin is a small, upmarket beach area between Kamala and Bang Tao on Phuket's west coast. Projects in our catalogue here are condominiums close to Surin Beach, with Bang Tao and the Laguna area a few minutes north.

Why buyers choose Surin

  • Compact, attractive beach with rocky headlands
  • Luxury resorts and villas along the coast
  • Close to Bang Tao, Laguna and Kamala
  • Limited supply of new projects

Neighbouring areas in our catalogue: Bang Tao · Kamala · Laguna

Lifestyle and amenities

Surin offers beach restaurants, upscale resorts and easy access to the shops and restaurants of Bang Tao and Laguna. It is quiet in the evenings.

Beaches and surroundings

Surin Beach is a short, steep beach that is beautiful in the dry season but can have strong waves and currents from about May to October; surfers use it in the monsoon season.

Rental demand in Surin

Surin's rental market is small and upmarket, aimed at guests who value a quieter, more exclusive beach. Demand is seasonal and depends on quality and management.

Short-term holiday rentals

High-end condos and villas let to couples and families who want a smaller beach; the dry season is the main period.

Long-term rentals

Limited, mainly well-off long-stay residents.

Suitable property types

Premium condos and luxury villas.

Advantages and limitations

Advantage: scarce supply and an upmarket reputation. Limitations: high prices, a small market and seasonality.

General market observations, not verified statistics. No rental income or occupancy is guaranteed; developer-advertised returns are not market results.

Rental and investment in Surin

Surin is a lifestyle-led luxury location. Buyers usually prioritise personal use and long-term value of a scarce location over high rental income.

Typical investor profiles

Luxury second-home owners and buyers of premium condos.

Risks to consider

A small buyer and tenant pool at the top end of the market; resale can take time.

Ownership costs

Higher common fees in premium buildings, villa maintenance, management and insurance.

Surin: frequently asked questions

Is Surin Beach good for swimming?

From about November to April Surin is good for swimming; in the monsoon months the beach is steep and the waves can be dangerous, so check the flags.

What is "Millionaire's Mile" in Phuket?

It is the stretch of coast between Kamala and Surin known for exclusive private villas.

How far is Surin from the airport?

Our project data gives about 23 km to Phuket International Airport, usually around 30 to 40 minutes by car.

Is Surin close to Bang Tao and Laguna?

Yes, Bang Tao and the Laguna Phuket area are just north of Surin, a few minutes by car.

Are there many new projects in Surin?

Supply is limited compared with Bang Tao or Cherng Talay; our catalogue lists only a small number of projects here.

How much does property in Surin cost?

Advertised starting prices for projects in Surin run from ฿5,513,000 to ฿10,600,000 (2 of 2 projects publish a price). These are lowest advertised prices; ask us to confirm current availability.
